messages:
Alice_Partners: Quick sync — partner playbook rollcall for the Marketplace launch (week of Jul 12). I want to confirm: press embargo windows, SI onboarding checklist, hw partner certification slots, and any last-minute legal asks.
Ben_Eng: Can we lock the integration API surface by EOD Wed? still poking at an edge case with auth headers.
Clara_Mktg: Press calendar: embargo drafts are ready, but need legal signoff + final product blurb from eng. Pinged design for hero assets.
Devin_Legal: Reviewing embargo language now. Two asks: (1) no customer names in early press, (2) verify third-party logo usage for HW partners.
Evan_SI: SI onboarding checklist looks ok but we need a dev sandbox account for partner engineers — can we provision scoped tokens for them?
Alice_Partners: @Evan_SI yes — we planned scoped tokens. @Ben_Eng can you share the token provisioning snippet?
Ben_Eng: putting snippet here — simple curl to the token service:
```
POST /api/v1/tokens
body: {"role":"partner","scopes":["read:models","deploy:workloads"],"expires_in":86400}
```
Use the partner-qa env.
Clara_Mktg: timeline check — marketing needs final hero + 2 quotes by Thu noon to meet design and PR deadlines.
Devin_Legal: noted. For the quotes, legal can clear attribution but avoid product specifics. Send quote drafts over.
Evan_SI: Token approach works. We also need a small onboarding doc for SI engineers with example workloads and perf baselines. Can the runtime team drop a 1-pager?
Ben_Eng: I'll produce a 1-pager perf snapshot (latency, batch settings, req/second) by tomorrow morning.
ReleaseBot: Deploy scheduled: marketplace-catalog v1.0 -> staging at 2024-07-05T02:00Z. Watch the #release-war-room thread for pipeline logs.
Alice_Partners: Action items summary: 1) @Devin_Legal finish embargo + logo guidance (Thu AM). 2) @Ben_Eng token snippet + perf 1-pager (tomorrow). 3) @Evan_SI onboarding doc + partner sandbox token validation (Fri). 4) @Clara_Mktg collect quotes + hero copy (Thu noon). I'll compile the partner-facing playbook after items close. Any blockers? :eyes:
